Manage native provider bindings

Usage: larp cc provider [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  detect    Find provider installations for onboarding
  bind      Bind an absolute native executable
  list      List provider bindings
  evidence  Print identity and SHA-256 of the bound executable (runs nothing)

Options:
      --json                                   Emit one local metadata JSON envelope
      --expected-revision <EXPECTED_REVISION>  Refuse if the registry revision has changed
  -h, --help                                   Print help
